source.title: Bitcoin to $1 MILLION by 2030? Mark Moss Reveals His Model
source.description:
Is Bitcoin's bottom finally in? Could BTC reach $1 MILLION by 2030? Investor and Bitcoin Opportunity Fund partner Mark Moss explains why he believes Bitcoin is entering one of the biggest buying opportunities in its history, despite recent crypto hacks and market uncertainty. He breaks down why Bitcoin could hit new all-time highs in 2027, how Wall Street adoption could push BTC to $1 million, and whether Strategy (MSTR) could outperform Bitcoin itself. Plus, Moss explains why he believes AI has killed the altcoin market and where investors should position themselves for the next bull run.
